note: Historical archive for KAM. Extracted from the team's 'FaZe Clan: A Timeline, 2010–2026' PDF; each entry cites its page and the PDF's own sources. Summaries are the PDF's text, unedited.

moments.title: Founded as FaZe Sniping
moments.summary: Founded as FaZe Sniping Eric “ClipZ” Rivera, Jeff “House Cat” Emann and Ben “Resistance” Christensen start a Call of Duty trickshotting crew on YouTube.

moments.title: The first upload
moments.summary: The first upload — “FaZe Sniping Intro” 475,099 lifetime views. The channel goes live the day after the crew forms: three players, one Intervention, and no plan beyond the next clip. A “FaZe Clan Minitage” and ILLCAMS Episode 1 both land within seventy-two hours.

moments.title: ILLCAMS Episode 1
moments.summary: ILLCAMS Episode 1 1.40M lifetime views, uploaded three days after the channel opened — not months later, as most retrospectives have it. The killcam-compilation format becomes the channel's subscriber engine for four straight years and runs to Episode 49 before going dark.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Temperrr
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Temperrr 1.62M views on the intro video. Thomas “Temperrr” Oliveira joins at sixteen, brings the graphic-design skills that produce the logo — his concept, drawn up by FaZe designer Joey “Ferox” Ricciuto, a reversed F overlapping a C — invents the shot that carries his name, and ends up the org's president. Earlier versions of this page dated his arrival to July on a year-level source; the channel's own introduction video puts it here.

moments.title: Temperrr invents his signature no-scope shot
moments.summary: Temperrr invents his signature no-scope shot Thomas “Temperrr” Oliveira originates a jump-spin, fire-without-scoping sniper trick that the community starts calling the “Temperrr Shot” — one of the earliest tricks to carry a FaZe member's own name.

moments.title: OpTic's H3CZ turns up on the FaZe channel “OpTic H3CZ Meets FaZe!”,
moments.summary: OpTic's H3CZ turns up on the FaZe channel “OpTic H3CZ Meets FaZe!”, 285K views. Two and a half years before the two orgs first meet in a bracket, Call of Duty's defining rivalry starts life as a crossover video — which is roughly how H3CZ has always described it.

moments.title: “Our War” — the first teamtage
moments.summary: “Our War” — the first teamtage 576,571 views, a Black Ops Search and Destroy team montage teased since Nov 18. The teamtage — the whole roster's clips cut to one track and dropped like a record — begins here. Roughly fifty follow over the next fifteen years.

moments.title: House Cat becomes FaZe
moments.summary: House Cat becomes FaZe Timid “Re-Introducing FaZe Timid.” Co-founder Jeff Emann retires the name the org was founded under. Of the three founders, he is the one whose alias most fans never learn. 2011

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Fakie
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Fakie 2.46M views on the intro alone. Ted “Fakie” becomes the channel's most prolific personality — “Fakie has Game!!” runs 38 episodes — and the on-camera voice FaZe puts forward whenever it has to answer for itself.

moments.title: “How to Temperrr Shot” does
moments.summary: “How to Temperrr Shot” does 5.75M views A tutorial, not a montage, and the most-watched video of FaZe's first two years. The move gets a name, the name gets a how-to, and a generation of Xbox 360 players learns it from the person it is named after. “How to Top Spin” with Fakie follows on Feb 6 (1.52M).

moments.title: FaZe Top 5 Trickshots, Episode 1
moments.summary: FaZe Top 5 Trickshots, Episode 1 2.15M views, hosted by Temperrr. A weekly leaderboard for the community's best clips — FaZe positioning itself as the scene's judge rather than just another crew in it. The series runs, on and off, for years.

moments.title: FaZe Apex joins on his fourteenth birthday
moments.summary: FaZe Apex joins on his fourteenth birthday Yousef “Apex” Abdelfattah joins, by his own account, the day he turned 14; the channel's introduction video follows on Mar 19 and does 1.60M views. He becomes COO, lands the first Black Ops 2 trickshot killcam, and leaves in the Christmas 2025 exodus — a little under fifteen years later.

moments.title: The community montage franchise begins “The Community TrickShot Montage Trailer,”
moments.summary: The community montage franchise begins “The Community TrickShot Montage Trailer,” 273K views on the trailer alone. FaZe starts cutting montages from clips sent in by people who are not in FaZe — the single smartest thing the org did in its first two years, and the reason the scene grew up around it rather than beside it.

moments.title: “FaZe Does Not Set Up Clips”
moments.summary: “FaZe Does Not Set Up Clips” 802K views. Accused of staging trickshots in rigged private lobbies, the crew answers with a Fakie commentary defending the clips as legitimate. The first time FaZe has to defend its own credibility on camera — and the template for every response video that follows.
citations: FaZe Clan YouTube — upload no longer public

moments.title: 100,000 subscribers Marked with a video titled “FaZe thanks you for 100k!!!!!!!!!!!”
moments.summary: 100,000 subscribers Marked with a video titled “FaZe thanks you for 100k!!!!!!!!!!!” — eleven exclamation marks, eleven months after the first upload.

moments.title: “Historic: A Community Montage,” on the first anniversary
moments.summary: “Historic: A Community Montage,” on the first anniversary 302K views, released a year to the day after the first upload. ILLFEEDS Episode 1 (452K) lands the same day — a second franchise spun out of the ILLCAMS format.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Spratt
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Spratt James “Spratt” joins and becomes the defining sniper of the Modern Warfare 3 era — fourteen prestige montages, the EXAMPLE series, and the first MW3 sniper montage on the channel. Twelve years later FaZe asks him back to lead a revived sniping division; the layoffs kill it before it launches. Watch the intro video.

moments.title: “Sniping With Style” Episode 1
moments.summary: “Sniping With Style” Episode 1 836K views. Another format built to showcase the roster collectively rather than one member at a time.

moments.title: PARALLEL — Fakie and Temperrr's dualtage
moments.summary: PARALLEL — Fakie and Temperrr's dualtage 3.30M views, edited by MinK and trailed since May 14 (the trailer alone did 1.22M). The dualtage as an event: two members, one montage, months of build-up. Nothing on the channel outside the Temperrr Shot tutorial touches it until the 1M teamtage.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Heist
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Heist 205,871 views. Heist runs the “No Witnesses” series and two of the era's better-remembered montages — STASIS in November 2011 and DEVIATE, edited by MinK, in October 2012.

moments.title: 300,000 subscribers
moments.summary: 300,000 subscribers 588,635 views on the thank-you video — more than five times the subscriber count it was celebrating. Four months from 100K to 300K.

moments.title: “Legendary: A Community Montage”
moments.summary: “Legendary: A Community Montage” 228,959 views, edited by FaZe Agony — the third entry in the community-montage line after March's trailer and May's “Historic,” and the one longtime fans still name first. Its own description places it in a sequence with an earlier entry, “Belief,” which does not survive on the main channel.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Ramos
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Ramos 377,544 views. Ramos becomes one of the most imitated trickshotters of the era — enough that a shot ends up carrying his name, the way Temperrr's did. His “Go On Ramos!” series runs sixteen episodes across four Call of Duty titles.

moments.title: “Clash of the Clan”
moments.summary: “Clash of the Clan” — 400,000 subscribers 586,812 views. An intra-roster tournament built as a subscriber-milestone event; it comes back for the two-year anniversary in 2012 and as North America vs Europe in 2013. FaZe competing against itself, on camera, years before it competed against anyone else.

moments.title: Hoodie Allen guests on “Fakie has Game” Episode 35,
moments.summary: Hoodie Allen guests on “Fakie has Game” Episode 35, 442K views. The first rapper crossover on the channel — and the same artist FaZe brings back three years later to headline ILLCAMS 49. Music-adjacent celebrity was in the formula from 2011, not from the Sports Illustrated era.
citations: FaZe Clan YouTube — upload no longer public

moments.title: Modern Warfare 3 Teamtage #1
moments.summary: Modern Warfare 3 Teamtage #1 1.60M views, three days after the game launched. Seven numbered MW3 teamtages follow through July 2012 — the most sustained numbered teamtage run the org ever managed, and evidence that the “no numbered series” claim only holds for the milestone tages, not the game-specific ones.

moments.title: Spratt's first MW3 sniper montage
moments.summary: Spratt's first MW3 sniper montage 1.05M views, six days into the new game's life cycle. Being first mattered more than being best: FaZe's whole growth pattern in this era is claiming a new title's sniping meta before anyone else has finished installing it. 02 2012-13 — A million subscribers, and a first run at the pros 2012

moments.title: ILLCAMS 36, and
moments.summary: ILLCAMS 36, and 500,000 subscribers 1.79M views, with the milestone folded into the episode title rather than given its own video. Nineteen months from launch to half a million.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Twistt
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Twistt 392,834 views. Worth separating from a much later name: this is FaZe Twistt the trickshotter, no relation to Russel “Twistzz” Van Dulken, the Counter-Strike rifler FaZe signs in 2021.

moments.title: The first MW3 crane shot killcam
moments.summary: The first MW3 crane shot killcam 971,201 views, hit by FaZe Force. The “first on a new map or mechanic” video becomes a reliable million-view format all by itself — the channel ran the same play for Sanctuary, Uplink, Dig and the Ghosts launch.

moments.title: ILLCAMS Episode 38
moments.summary: ILLCAMS Episode 38 — the real series peak, at 5.44M Edited by MinK, 5,441,508 lifetime views, and the highest-viewed ILLCAMS ever made by a wide margin. An earlier version of this page gave that title to Episode 49; the catalogue does not support it. Episodes 39 (3.31M), 37 (2.89M), 40 (2.89M) and 43 (2.44M) all out-perform 49's 2.33M as well.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Pamaj
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Pamaj 850,248 views. Austin Pamajewon joins and becomes, on the numbers, the single biggest draw of the trickshot era — his Black Ops 2 and MW2/MW3 montages are the two most-watched member videos the channel ever published. An earlier version of this page carried a “correction” claiming Pamaj was never on the FaZe roster and belonged entirely to OpTic. That was wrong in both directions, and it is retracted here: he starts at FaZe. Watch the intro video.

moments.title: Pamaj: Iridescent 3
moments.summary: Pamaj: Iridescent 3 1.65M views, ten days after his introduction video. The fastest any member has gone from joining to carrying the channel.

moments.title: WaRTeK: World War III
moments.summary: WaRTeK: World War III 1.15M views. Anil “WaRTeK” Brancaleoni is already the biggest French name on the roster seventeen months before FaZe builds an entire European division around him.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe zejiM
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe zejiM 361,507 views. zejiM's mid-air tagshot is still passed around as one of the defining clips of the Black Ops and MW2 sniping era — the kind of shot that gets re-uploaded by nostalgia accounts a decade later without anyone needing to caption it.

moments.title: Clash of the Clan 2
moments.summary: Clash of the Clan 2 — two years of FaZe 720,820 views, dropped on the anniversary. The org is two years old, has more than half a million subscribers, and has still never entered a professional tournament.

moments.title: G FUEL partnership begins
moments.summary: G FUEL partnership begins One of the org's longest-running and most fan-associated brand deals, still active over a decade later.

moments.title: Spratt: EXAMPLE 3
moments.summary: Spratt: EXAMPLE 3 847,157 views. The EXAMPLE line is the closest thing the sniping side had to a prestige franchise under one member's name; EXAMPLE 4 follows in August 2013 at 1.53M.

moments.title: First turn toward competitive esports
moments.summary: First turn toward competitive esports The crew starts recruiting competitive Call of Duty players alongside its content side, aiming at the Call of Duty Championship.

moments.title: Pamaj: THE CATALYST
moments.summary: Pamaj: THE CATALYST 5,363,906 views — at the time the biggest single-member video FaZe had ever released, and still third on the all-time list behind only the 1M teamtage and Pamaj's own Black Ops 2 montage two months later.

moments.title: CONFLICTION — Ramos and zejiM's dualtage
moments.summary: CONFLICTION — Ramos and zejiM's dualtage 1,722,910 views, edited by Meek and trailed since Aug 24. The biggest dualtage since PARALLEL fourteen months earlier, and the clearest example of the format at its peak: two of the roster's most technical snipers, one release date, a month of build.

moments.title: The 1 Million Subscribers Teamtage
moments.summary: The 1 Million Subscribers Teamtage — 12.1M views, and the biggest video FaZe ever made Edited by MinK. At 12,134,253 lifetime views it is more than double the next-biggest teamtage and the most-watched upload in the channel's history, in any era, by any member. An earlier version of this page called the 2013 2M Subscribers Teamtage (5.47M) the biggest ever. It is second.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Rain
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Rain 490,526 views. Nordan “Rain” Shat becomes one of the channel's most-watched personalities and, by 2014, its biggest solo montage draw. Note the date: the org's own introduction video puts him at October 2012, not 2011, which is what several later retrospectives report.

moments.title: Black Ops 2 sets off a second trickshotting boom
moments.summary: Black Ops 2 sets off a second trickshotting boom The new Call of Duty entry and its Ballista rifle trigger a fresh wave of viral clips, and FaZe takes the whole launch window: Pamaj's first BO2 sniper montage (8.0M), Apex's first BO2 trickshot killcam (1.7M) and BO2 Teamtage #1 (2.0M) all land inside 48 hours. An earlier version of this page used this entry to “correct” a claim that Pamaj was a FaZe name, asserting his fame ran entirely through OpTic. That was itself the error, and it is withdrawn — Pamaj was on FaZe from March 2012, and this is his window. Watch: Pamaj’s BO2 montage, Apex’s k

moments.title: Apex lands the first Black Ops 2 trickshot killcam
moments.summary: Apex lands the first Black Ops 2 trickshot killcam 1.71M views. The same day as Pamaj's montage: FaZe took the first-on-a-new-game slot twice over, with the org's future COO getting one of them.

moments.title: Pamaj's first Black Ops 2 sniper montage
moments.summary: Pamaj's first Black Ops 2 sniper montage — 8.0M views 8,005,940 lifetime views, published the day after the game's launch window opened. The second-most-watched video in FaZe history, behind only the 1M teamtage — and the single clearest illustration of how much of the trickshot era's reach ran through one person.

moments.title: Black Ops 2 Teamtage #1
moments.summary: Black Ops 2 Teamtage #1 2.00M views, forty-eight hours after the game arrived. Four numbered BO2 teamtages follow in six weeks.

moments.title: “Our War 2” 1.09M views, edited by Meek, two years to the day after the original
moments.summary: “Our War 2” 1.09M views, edited by Meek, two years to the day after the original. The only teamtage FaZe ever made a direct sequel to.

moments.title: The Christmas teamtage tradition actually starts here “Black Ops 2 Teamtage #3 (Holiday Sp
moments.summary: The Christmas teamtage tradition actually starts here “Black Ops 2 Teamtage #3 (Holiday Special!),” edited by MinK, 1,402,497 views — a year earlier than this page previously said, and comfortably the biggest of the five holiday drops. The run then goes 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 before lapsing. 2013

moments.title: FaZe Rug joins
moments.summary: FaZe Rug joins Brian “Rug” Awadis joins the org roughly six months after launching his own channel. He'll become its biggest individual YouTuber and stay 13 years.

moments.title: MLG Winter Championship: rough competitive debut FaZe's first organized Call of Duty tourn
moments.summary: MLG Winter Championship: rough competitive debut FaZe's first organized Call of Duty tournament appearance, and the team (Heist, Secretly, Folsom and ShamRoKz) secures a spot in the Championship Bracket at MLG Dallas on Mar 16 (https://x.com/FaZeClan/status/312819398140379136). The esports project is real now, and the results begin to follow.

moments.title: FaZe Banks joins, from rival SoaR Gaming
moments.summary: FaZe Banks joins, from rival SoaR Gaming Richard “Banks” Bengtson crosses over after leading SoaR's own trickshot/highlight channel. Later becomes COO, then CEO.

moments.title: #FAZE5 — the original recruitment challenge
moments.summary: #FAZE5 — the original recruitment challenge 564K views on the announcement. Seven years before the 2020 edition most people remember, FaZe runs the first #FAZE5: send clips, get shortlisted, get judged in public. A Top 100 update follows in April and a Top 20 montage in May (1.57M).

moments.title: Clash of the Clan 3: North America vs Europe
moments.summary: Clash of the Clan 3: North America vs Europe 1,065,214 views, edited by Gumi and Furran. The roster is now big enough and international enough to field two continents against each other.

moments.title: First match against OpTic Gaming
moments.summary: First match against OpTic Gaming A loss at MLG Spring Championship, but the start of what becomes Call of Duty esports' defining rivalry — one OpTic's own founder H3CZ later described as more mentorship than beef. Jun 3–7,

moments.title: The first #FAZE5 class joins, one a day for five days Rockst4r (Jun 3), Tettoe (Jun 4), Ha
moments.summary: The first #FAZE5 class joins, one a day for five days Rockst4r (Jun 3), Tettoe (Jun 4), Hateful (Jun 5), GwidT (Jun 6) and Bazzles (Jun 7, with editor Ninjask added the same day) each get a full introduction video, staged across five consecutive days on the org's third anniversary week. Recruitment as episodic content — a format FaZe reruns in 2014 and again in

moments.title: “FaZe @ MLG Anaheim 2013”
moments.summary: “FaZe @ MLG Anaheim 2013” 463K views. The content side shows up at a professional LAN and vlogs it — months before the competitive side has a result worth reporting. FaZe covered esports as culture before it could compete in it. “FaZe @ MLG Columbus” follows in November (697K).

moments.title: Spratt: EXAMPLE 4
moments.summary: Spratt: EXAMPLE 4 1,527,029 views. The last of the truly enormous single-member sniping montages before the org's attention moves to esports rosters and, later, to lifestyle content.

moments.title: 3rd–4th at the PAX Prime CoD Invitational
moments.summary: 3rd–4th at the PAX Prime CoD Invitational A $1,250 finish — modest money, but the first result on the board after the MLG Winter Championship, and a sign the competitive side is finding its footing.

moments.title: FaZe eSniping launches, led by WaRTeK
moments.summary: FaZe eSniping launches, led by WaRTeK A dedicated European sniping/content division — the first seed of the international expansion that becomes FaZe France seven months later.

moments.title: The 2 Million Subscribers Teamtage
moments.summary: The 2 Million Subscribers Teamtage Edited by Gumi, 5.47M lifetime views, trailed since June (the trailer alone did 879K) in a months-long hype cycle that treated a montage drop like an album release. It is the second-biggest teamtage FaZe ever released — an earlier version of this page called it the biggest, before the 2012 1M teamtage's 12.1M turned up in the catalogue.

moments.title: Ghosts Teamtage #1
moments.summary: Ghosts Teamtage #1 848K views, two days after the 2M teamtage — the game-specific sub-series format that runs alongside the numbered milestone teamtages.

moments.title: ACE and Enable join the competitive team “A very large welcome to the newest members of th
moments.summary: ACE and Enable join the competitive team “A very large welcome to the newest members of the @FaZeCompetitive team,” FaZe posts of MLG ACE and Enable, the two players who become FaZe Red’s core.

moments.title: #FAZE5 Top 20 absorbed into the roster Banks posts that Adapt, Baz, Carl, GwidT, Kayos, Li
moments.summary: #FAZE5 Top 20 absorbed into the roster Banks posts that Adapt, Baz, Carl, GwidT, Kayos, Linkzy, Rockst4r, Sully and TeeTo all placed in the Top 20 for #FAZE5 and “have all joined FaZe.” It is the first public sign that the contest is a recruiting pipeline for the roster, not only a content series.

moments.title: Christmas Teamtage, year two
moments.summary: Christmas Teamtage, year two Edited by MinK and Racky, 469K views, dropped the day after Christmas — the second in what becomes a five-year holiday run, every one landing Dec 24–26.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Adapt
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Adapt 356,649 views, edited by FaZe Ninja. This is the org's own introduction video for Adapt, and it settles a genuine reporting conflict: Streamscharts dates his join to 2011 and Dexerto to 2013, but the channel announced him in January 2014, and Banks had already posted in Dec 2013 that Adapt had placed in the #FAZE5 Top 20 and joined FaZe (https://x.com/Banks/status/409230065717608448). He goes on to direct FaZe's Call of Duty sniping division, and leaves in the Christmas 2025 exodus.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Kay
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Kay 1,075,920 views. Frazier Khattri joins, becomes one of the org's most visible UK creators, and is the member FaZe fires seven years later over the Save the Kids token.

moments.title: First content house opens, in Plainview, NY Temperrr and Banks set up shared living/conten
moments.summary: First content house opens, in Plainview, NY Temperrr and Banks set up shared living/content space, marking the pivot from pure trickshot channel to lifestyle brand.

moments.title: “The FaZe Application Process”
moments.summary: “The FaZe Application Process” 966,653 views. The org publishes how to get in — and turns its own hiring funnel into a content format that a million people watch. Nothing else in gaming was doing membership this transparently in 2014.

moments.title: FaZe qualify for Call of Duty Championship FaZe qualify for the 2014 Call of Duty Champion
moments.summary: FaZe qualify for Call of Duty Championship FaZe qualify for the 2014 Call of Duty Championship, where they finish 6th three weeks later.

moments.title: 6th at Call of Duty Championship 2014, $50,000
moments.summary: 6th at Call of Duty Championship 2014, $50,000 A real payday and a real result, though well short of the podium — a fair marker of where the competitive side stands one year after the MLG Winter Championship.

moments.title: FaZe eSniping renamed FaZe France
moments.summary: FaZe eSniping renamed FaZe France The European sniping/content division, led by WaRTeK, gets its own identity as the org's first international expansion.

moments.title: #RELAPSE teamtage
moments.summary: #RELAPSE teamtage Edited by Xero and Furran, 1.78M lifetime views.

moments.title: #FAZE5 returns, powered by G FUEL
moments.summary: #FAZE5 returns, powered by G FUEL 480,805 views. The second edition, now with a title sponsor attached — the first time FaZe monetises its

moments.title: ILLCAMS Episode 49, and then three years of silence Featuring rapper Hoodie Allen for the
moments.summary: ILLCAMS Episode 49, and then three years of silence Featuring rapper Hoodie Allen for the second time, 2.33M views — a strong episode, though not the series record that this page previously claimed for it. Then it simply stopped. “Where is ILLCAMS 50?” became a running joke for three years; FaZe even tweeted that it was “Coming out TOMORROW” on Feb 6, 2016, then did not deliver it for another fifteen months.

moments.title: “Player Profile: FaZe Censor”
moments.summary: “Player Profile: FaZe Censor” 414,797 views. The competitive Call of Duty roster gets the same treatment the trickshotters get — a produced player profile rather than a results post. FaZe is building personalities out of pros a full year before most orgs try it.

moments.title: Introducing FaZe Jev
moments.summary: Introducing FaZe Jev 2.27M views on the intro, edited by FaZe Barker. Jason “Jev” Eugene brings a rage-commentary and sniping channel that grows to 5.4M subscribers and becomes one of the longest tenures in the org's history — roughly twelve years, outlasting nearly every name around him. He leaves on Jan 1, 2026, in the last wave of the exodus. Earlier reporting placed his join in August; the channel's own introduction video is May.

moments.title: The second #FAZE5 class arrives Dirty, Brio, Bobo, NiQs and Agony are introduced across Ju
moments.summary: The second #FAZE5 class arrives Dirty, Brio, Bobo, NiQs and Agony are introduced across June, with a combined class video (1.03M) closing it out. Curtis “Dirty” Henke is still on the roster nine years later, and is one of the two names FaZe wants for its 2023 sniping revival.

moments.title: Wins the MLG 2K Series
moments.summary: Wins the MLG 2K Series A first-place finish that, paired with the Columbus Open win over OpTic later that year, makes 2014 the competitive side's best year yet.

moments.title: FaZe Rain's 1 Million Subscribers montage
moments.summary: FaZe Rain's 1 Million Subscribers montage 3.55M lifetime views, the biggest solo montage of the golden era and a reminder that individual members were becoming draws in their own right.

moments.title: Beats OpTic at the MLG Columbus Open
moments.summary: Beats OpTic at the MLG Columbus Open A marquee win over the chief rival, despite ACHES suffering a severe hand injury mid-tournament.

moments.title: #RED teamtage
moments.summary: #RED teamtage A multi-Call-of-Duty teamtage edited by FaZe Barker, 4.55M views — second only to the 2M Subscribers Teamtage.

moments.title: FaZe Rug uploads his first prank video
moments.summary: FaZe Rug uploads his first prank video

moments.title: Christmas Teamtage, year three
moments.summary: Christmas Teamtage, year three Edited by Racky, 340K views. Third year running, and the holiday drop is now an expectation rather than a one-off. 2015

moments.title: FaZe Red take 3rd at the Call of Duty Championship ACHES, SlasheR, Parasite and Enable, tr
moments.summary: FaZe Red take 3rd at the Call of Duty Championship ACHES, SlasheR, Parasite and Enable, transferred over from the main roster, put FaZe on a Championship podium for the first time. It is the high point of the FaZe Red era.

moments.title: ZooMaa joins FaZe for the first time
moments.summary: ZooMaa joins FaZe for the first time Tommy “ZooMaa” Paparatto signs for the first time and becomes the face of FaZe’s Call of Duty side for the next decade. He marks the ten-year anniversary on X in 2025 (152K views, 4.3K likes).

moments.title: Hubrick investment brings in Lee Trink Entrepreneur Sebastian Geurts invests via Hubrick a
moments.summary: Hubrick investment brings in Lee Trink Entrepreneur Sebastian Geurts invests via Hubrick and brings former Interscope Records executive Lee Trink on as an advisor. Trink later becomes CEO.

moments.title: The Call of Duty side splits into FaZe Red and FaZe Black
moments.summary: The Call of Duty side splits into FaZe Red and FaZe Black Two rosters under one banner, with players moved between them mid-season. It doubles FaZe's shots at a bracket and dilutes the identity of both teams; the org repeats the split in 2016 before consolidating back to a single roster.

moments.title: FaZe France's roster and staff walk out
moments.summary: FaZe France's roster and staff walk out The whole French division leaves, citing dissatisfaction with FaZe's plans for it, and goes on to found its own org. First real fracture of the international side.

moments.title: Clayster joins the competitive Call of Duty roster
moments.summary: Clayster joins the competitive Call of Duty roster James “Clayster” Eubanks, already one of the scene's most decorated players, spends two seasons on FaZe before later winning CWL/CDL titles elsewhere.

moments.title: Runner-up at MLG World Finals

moments.title: Two Call of Duty trophies in seven weeks, both taken off OpTic FaZe beat OpTic 4–3 to win
moments.summary: Two Call of Duty trophies in seven weeks, both taken off OpTic FaZe beat OpTic 4–3 to win the Gfinity Summer Championship in London, then beat them again 4–1 to take MLG Pro League Season 3. The rivalry that began as a 2010 crossover video is now a final, twice in a summer, and FaZe win both.

moments.summary: The lifestyle side moves to LA and the “Clout House” Banks relocates out of Plainview into the LA creator-house scene, founding the Clout Gang collective alongside FaZe. Exact date unconfirmed; the Clout House and FaZe's own houses were adjacent but separate operations.

moments.summary: Wins ELEAGUE CS:GO Premier, $500K Beats Astralis 2-0 in the final (16-14 Cache, 16-7 Overpass), the superteam's highest-profile trophy of the year.

moments.summary: Enters Rainbow Six Siege, acquires Team Fontt Buys the Brazilian squad (gohaN, Astro, cameram4n, HSnamuringa, mav), already qualified for that year's Six Invitational — FaZe's entry into a third major esport, one that takes seven years to pay off with a trophy.

moments.title: Runner-up at the CS:GO ELEAGUE Major, Boston
moments.summary: Runner-up at the CS:GO ELEAGUE Major, Boston Loses the final to Cloud9 — part of what's later tallied as four Major final losses, tied for the most of any org, before the superteam ever wins one outright.

moments.summary: Wins CWL Pro League Stage 1, beating OpTic in the final 3–2 for $212,500, and the last significant Call of Duty title the FaZe Clan name wins before franchising moves the team to Atlanta. Four months later the roster takes third at the Call of Duty World League Championship.

moments.title: Tfue joins FaZe Clan
moments.summary: Tfue joins FaZe Clan Turner “Tfue” Tenney, already rising fast in Fortnite, signs on — about to become the org's single biggest streaming asset.

moments.title: Tfue's 30-day Twitch suspension, cut short by backlash
moments.summary: Tfue's 30-day Twitch suspension, cut short by backlash A smaller precursor controversy over stream language, resolved to roughly a week after public pushback — a year before the lawsuit.

moments.title: Wins IEM Sydney
moments.summary: Wins IEM Sydney Beats Astralis in the grand final — a genuine trophy for the superteam roster, even as the bigger Major title keeps eluding it.

moments.title: Greg Selkoe becomes president, Lee Trink becomes CEO
moments.summary: Greg Selkoe becomes president, Lee Trink becomes CEO The Karmaloop founder joins as president alongside Trink's move from advisor to chief executive — the moment FaZe stops being run only by the people who founded it. Both are gone by 2023.

moments.title: Expands to a three-mansion Hollywood Hills compound
moments.summary: Expands to a three-mansion Hollywood Hills compound One house for FaZe's owners, one for the “Clout Gang” lifestyle crew, one for the Fortnite pros (Tfue, Cloakzy, Adapt, Temperrr) — all within two doors of each other, at a combined $100,000/month Banks discloses on Twitter.

moments.title: FaZe Rain breaks his silence on depression Rain publishes a video explaining the break in
moments.summary: FaZe Rain breaks his silence on depression Rain publishes a video explaining the break in his uploads: a breakdown in April 2018, self-harm, several days in hospital and then a psychiatric ward. He is explicit that money did not touch the anxiety or the depression. One of the earliest times a creator at this scale said it plainly, and it reached an audience most mental-health campaigns never do.

moments.title: Nate Hill signs to the Fortnite roster
moments.summary: Nate Hill signs to the Fortnite roster The first of the competitive Fortnite signings that build toward the 2019 World Cup run, and the player FaZe later fields alongside Marshmello on the Verizon lockdown fundraiser. Four days after signing, he wins $120,000 at Summer Skirmish on Sept 3 (https://x.com/FaZeClan/status/1036750968568799232).

moments.title: CouRage joins the Black Ops 4 roster FaZe adds CouRage as the fifth player on its Call of
moments.summary: CouRage joins the Black Ops 4 roster FaZe adds CouRage as the fifth player on its Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 roster.

moments.title: Champion apparel partnership
moments.summary: Champion apparel partnership Debuts as a 100-hoodie ComplexCon exclusive sold through Tfue's booth earlier that month, then goes wide with a Black Friday drop announced Nov 22. An early push into lifestyle-brand territory, and the start of FaZe's best-selling merch franchise — a later drop sells out in 28 minutes.

moments.title: Cellium signs to the Call of Duty roster Cellium signs to FaZe’s Call of Duty roster, four
moments.summary: Cellium signs to the Call of Duty roster Cellium signs to FaZe’s Call of Duty roster, four months before the team re-enters the CWL. 2019

moments.summary: Nissan sponsorship begins Logos on competition jerseys, vehicle access for content, and original YouTube series — a partnership that runs for years, later supplying the grand-prize GT-R for 2022's FaZe1 show.

moments.title: NBA centre Meyers Leonard invests
moments.summary: NBA centre Meyers Leonard invests One of the first athlete investors of the 2019 wave, and among the more active — he announces content plans alongside the investment rather than just taking the equity.

moments.title: “We’re baaaack”: FaZe re-enters the CWL FaZe announces its return to the Call of Duty Worl
moments.summary: “We’re baaaack”: FaZe re-enters the CWL FaZe announces its return to the Call of Duty World League with ZooMaa, Cellium, Asim, Skrapz and Zer0.

moments.summary: A Call of Duty League slot is bought for about $25M Activision confirms Atlanta Esports Ventures has purchased the franchise slot that becomes Atlanta FaZe. Note who paid: FaZe lends the brand, Cox-backed AEV puts up the money. The team FaZe is best known for winning with is not one it bought.

moments.title: Megga and Dubs join the Fortnite roster
moments.summary: Megga and Dubs join the Fortnite roster Two of the signings that make FaZe a genuine competitive Fortnite org rather than a content one, ten weeks before the World Cup.

moments.title: Tfue sues FaZe Clan Alleges an illegal, “grossly oppressive” talent-agency contract taking
moments.summary: Tfue sues FaZe Clan Alleges an illegal, “grossly oppressive” talent-agency contract taking up to 80% of certain earnings, plus pressure toward underage drinking and gambling. FaZe denies taking a cut of tournament or streaming winnings.

moments.title: FaZe answers the Tfue lawsuit FaZe replies the same day the suit lands, then posts a seven
moments.summary: FaZe answers the Tfue lawsuit FaZe replies the same day the suit lands, then posts a seven-minute “statement from FaZe Clan about contracts” on May 23.

moments.title: Nickmercs signs, days after the lawsuit breaks
moments.summary: Nickmercs signs, days after the lawsuit breaks Nick “Nickmercs” Kolcheff leaves 100 Thieves for FaZe. Former member Rain later claimed, without confirmation, it was partly damage control.

moments.title: H1ghSky1's real age surfaces, and Twitch removes his account
moments.summary: H1ghSky1's real age surfaces, and Twitch removes his account The Fortnite pro FaZe had signed turns out to be 12, under Twitch's minimum age; he admits the lie and moves to YouTube with a parent supervising. Epic bars him from oﬃcial tournaments until he turns 13. Tfue's lawsuit separately alleged FaZe knew a signed player was 11 while presenting him as 13 — the ugliest single thread in the Fortnite era.

moments.title: Mongraal signs ahead of the Fortnite World Cup 14-year-old prodigy
moments.summary: Mongraal signs ahead of the Fortnite World Cup 14-year-old prodigy Kyle “Mongraal” Jackson leaves Team Secret for FaZe's competitive Fortnite push.

moments.summary: Wins the PUBG Europe League, Phase 2 $100,000, and the start of the best season any FaZe PUBG roster has had. The title-winning core is mxey, Fuzzface, ubah and Aitzy.

moments.title: Wix becomes oﬃcial web design partner
moments.summary: Wix becomes oﬃcial web design partner One of a rapid run of 2019 brand deals as the partnerships operation scaled up under a new revenue team.

moments.summary: G FUEL launches ready-to-drink cans, and a FaZe Berry flavor FaZe gets its own named flavor seven years into the partnership — the licensing model that later scales into an equity stake.

moments.summary: Wins the GLL Grand Slam in Stockholm $130,000, beating Athletico, two weeks after the PEL title. The same month FaZe was drawing ten-thousand-person crowds to a New York pop-up, a different FaZe roster was quietly becoming the best PUBG team in Europe.

moments.summary: NYPD shuts down the NYC pop-up A one-day “FaZe Clan vs The World” takeover of Stadium Goods, timed to World Cup weekend, with roughly 30 members present. Fans camped overnight; police closed it about four hours in over crowd control. FaZe's own CRO later described 10,000+ fans and a line stretching over ten city blocks; his same-week post said six. Either way, the closest thing gaming had seen to rockstar crowds. Jul 26–28,

moments.summary: Fortnite World Cup, at Arthur Ashe Stadium in NYC Cizzorz and Fish Fam win the $1M Creative Finals outright; Mongraal places 6th Duo/13th Solo ($375K); Tfue finishes 67th Solo. G FUEL's “Road to the World Cup” series follows FaZe's six qualifiers through a pre-event training camp near the city. Across just its confirmed competitors, the org's combined haul lands somewhere in the $1.1M–$1.8M range depending how the Creative prize is split — no outlet published one clean org-wide total. moments.summary: Police shut down a FaZe Rug merch meetup too Roughly 7,000 fans turn up to a casual Santa Ana merch drop for FaZe's biggest individual YouTuber, and it's shut down by police — the second FaZe fan event closed by law enforcement inside of ten days.

moments.title: Burger King Impossible Whopper campaign

moments.summary: Migos' Offset joins as an investor Part of a wider 2019 wave of celebrity and athlete investors — Ray J, Pitbull, Lil Yachty, and NBA players including Ben Simmons and Jamal Murray.

moments.title: New Era headwear collaboration
moments.summary: New Era headwear collaboration The cap company that outfits Major League Baseball puts out a FaZe line — another brick in the 2019 wall

moments.title: Manchester City partnership
moments.summary: Manchester City partnership A Premier League champion signs a content and apparel deal with a trickshotting clan from Long Island. Of everything in the 2019 run, this is the one that most clearly says the category had arrived.

moments.title: Back-to-back: PUBG Europe League Phase 3 Another $100,000 and a second consecutive PEL cro
moments.summary: Back-to-back: PUBG Europe League Phase 3 Another $100,000 and a second consecutive PEL crown, completing a three-title season. On the European stage this is the high-water mark of FaZe's PUBG program.

moments.summary: Atlanta FaZe announced for the Call of Duty League A partnership with Atlanta Esports Ventures puts the FaZe name into the newly franchised CDL — the entity that becomes FaZe Vegas six years later, and the half of the business that survives the 2025 exodus intact.

moments.summary: Forbes ranks FaZe #4 in esports at $240M On roughly $35M revenue, with 19M social followers — more than the Dallas Cowboys and New York Yankees combined. CEO Lee Trink: “I wouldn't trade businesses with anyone else on this list.” Nov 5–6,

moments.summary: FaZe Arcade opens on Melrose — the first real storefront 7312 Melrose Ave, billed as FaZe's first branded retail pop-up: a Kappa collab launch, Edison Chen's CLOT to follow, and a Lyrical Lemonade project on Cyber Monday, with gaming rigs on site. Thousands turn out for opening weekend.

moments.summary: Runner-up at the PUBG Global Championship Second of sixteen at the sport’s first world final in Oakland, on 101 points to Gen.G’s 111, for $600,000 — the largest single cheque any FaZe roster had won to that date. moments.summary: Signs an all-Thai PUBG Mobile roster Vintorez (captain), BulShark, Maroon5 and Echo, formerly of EVOS Burnout, with coach MaFia — FaZe's first all-Asia roster and the third major Western org into PUBG Mobile after Cloud9 and Fnatic. The closest thing to a real Asia expansion the org has: a competitive roster in the region rather than a branded oﬃce.

moments.summary: Quibi announces the “FaZe Up” reality game show Six subscribers fly to the FaZe mansion to compete for a roster spot and prize money, building on an earlier Whistle Sports version from 2018. Quibi itself folds within the year.

moments.title: Sway signs to the Fortnite roster
moments.summary: Sway signs to the Fortnite roster Josh “Sway” Sway becomes one of the most-watched competitive Fortnite players on the roster, and one of the few from the era whose audience outlives the team.

moments.title: Fight2Fund COVID charity series
moments.summary: Fight2Fund COVID charity series A four-week charity Warzone content series with Alesso, Diplo and Marshmello, raising over $124,000 as live events shut down.

moments.summary: Fortnite coach tests positive for COVID-19

moments.title: Swagg joins — and brings the Nuke Squad
moments.summary: Swagg joins — and brings the Nuke Squad Kris “Swagg” Lamberson is surprised with the offer live on stream in front of thousands. His Warzone crew, the Nuke Squad, follows a year later (oﬃcially joined Mar 23, 2021): JSmooth, Santana and Booya all become FaZe members. Swagg stays five and a half years and leaves in the Christmas 2025 exodus.

moments.summary: The first NFL tie-up — the 2020 Draft-A-Thon FaZe joins the NFL's virtual draft-weekend fundraiser with an exclusive merchandise collaboration. moments.summary: FaZe Studios launches with Sugar23 A premium film and TV venture with producer Scott Budnick — the most ambitious version yet of the “we're a media company, not an esports team” thesis.

moments.summary: Beats by Dre collab caps the 10th-anniversary run Announced during “10 Days of FaZe,” the countdown to the May 30 anniversary, with a Powerbeats Pro colorway collection following in June. moments.summary: 10th anniversary retrospective, and a G-Shock collab A milestone video, “The Evolution of FaZe Clan,” pairs with a limited-edition FaZe-branded G-Shock watch — a small but genuinely nostalgic beat.

moments.title: “The FaZe House New York Reunites”
moments.summary: “The FaZe House New York Reunites” — an 11-years-of-FaZe reunion Apex, Banks, Teeqo, Adapt, Temperrr and Blaze return to the original Plainview, NY house to recount how they met and grew up together on Xbox — a rare on-camera reunion of the founding-era roster, most of whom are gone from the org within a few years of this video.

moments.title: Kalei Renay signs as a streamer
moments.summary: Kalei Renay signs as a streamer Two years after Ewok became the first woman on the roster, another individual step in a women's-representation push that stays signing-by-signing rather than a standing program. [The

moments.title: “Save the Kids” crypto scandal Four members promote a token that crashes within days of la
moments.summary: “Save the Kids” crypto scandal Four members promote a token that crashes within days of launch. FaZe permanently removes Kay, suspends Jarvis and Nikan; Teeqo is suspended (Jul 1), then reinstated Sept 10 after investigation.

moments.title: First esports org on the cover of Sports Illustrated
moments.summary: First esports org on the cover of Sports Illustrated The July 2021 issue's cover features Nickmercs, Swagg, Rug, Temperrr, Arizona Cardinals QB Kyler “FaZe K1” Murray, and a then-16-year-old LeBron James Jr., branded on the cover as “FaZe Bronny.” A mainstream-media legitimization moment for the whole category, not just FaZe.

moments.title: Atlanta FaZe win CDL Majors I, III and IV Atlanta FaZe win Call of Duty League Majors I, I
moments.summary: Atlanta FaZe win CDL Majors I, III and IV Atlanta FaZe win Call of Duty League Majors I, III and IV during the 2021 season, ahead of the Championship title on Aug 22.

moments.title: Takashi Murakami collaboration drops Limited-edition jerseys and mousepads carrying the ar
moments.summary: Takashi Murakami collaboration drops Limited-edition jerseys and mousepads carrying the artist's signature flower motifs, sold via NTWRK; Murakami compares the pairing to Warhol and Basquiat.

moments.title: Save the Kids: Kay fired, three members suspended After Coffeezilla traces wallet activity
moments.summary: Save the Kids: Kay fired, three members suspended After Coffeezilla traces wallet activity, FaZe removes Frazier “Kay” Khattri and suspends Jarvis, Nikan and Teeqo. Kay had cleared roughly $30,000 dumping about six billion tokens in the first 24 hours of a coin marketed as a children's charity; he later says refunds cost him $400,000–$500,000. Teeqo is reinstated after showing he was not involved. This is the consequence half of the June scandal, and the first time FaZe fires a member over money.

moments.title: Totino's — Lil Yachty hosts a series shot on a yacht
moments.summary: Totino's — Lil Yachty hosts a series shot on a yacht A content series for the launch of Totino's Pizza Rolls Minis, filmed the week before on a yacht in Marina Del Rey and airing that autumn, with Lil Yachty hosting Temperrr, Adapt, Rug, Swagg, JSmooth and Booya across episodes of gaming, fishing and cooking. CRO Jeff Pabst calls it “a perfect example” of integrating talent with brands; Totino's calls pizza rolls “the perfect streaming snack.” The deal lands three weeks after the Save the Kids fallout, and is the cleanest illustration of the 2021 model — a snack brand renting the roster.

moments.title: McDonald's sponsorship Content featuring FaZe members, funded by one of the largest advert
moments.summary: McDonald's sponsorship Content featuring FaZe members, funded by one of the largest advertisers on earth. Day-level date not published.

moments.title: Atlanta FaZe win the Call of Duty League Championship Beating Toronto Ultra 5-3 as the #1 seed
moments.summary: Atlanta FaZe win the Call of Duty League Championship Beating Toronto Ultra 5-3 as the #1 seed — as FaZe's own revenue chief put it, “our first world title in the game where it all started.” Eleven years after a Call of Duty sniping channel started uploading trickshots.

moments.title: The “everyone becomes a FaZe member” stunt goes viral FaZe promised that if Atlanta won th
moments.summary: The “everyone becomes a FaZe member” stunt goes viral FaZe promised that if Atlanta won the CDL Championship, everyone who liked the tweet could join FaZe. They won, and honored it as one-day memberships — brands piled in, and FaZe ended up posting that it “got ratiod by FaZe McDonald's.” A rare case of the org's internet instincts working perfectly in public.

moments.title: Named a Halo Championship Series partner team FaZe enters a fifth major esport as a franch
moments.summary: Named a Halo Championship Series partner team FaZe enters a fifth major esport as a franchise partner, and signs the Inconceivable roster — Bound, bubu dubu, Falcated and Snip3down — on Dec 13 to fill it.

moments.title: A FaZe Clan Batman comic, with DC
moments.summary: A FaZe Clan Batman comic, with DC A limited comic written by Josh Trujillo and illustrated by Scot Eaton. Improbable on paper, and exactly the kind of licensing reach the SPAC pitch was built on.

moments.title: Daniel Craig streams with the Nuke Squad, and Billie Eilish drops in
moments.summary: Daniel Craig streams with the Nuke Squad, and Billie Eilish drops in A No Time To Die promo stream with Swagg, Booya, Santana and JSmooth, complete with a surprise Billie Eilish cameo. Peak crossover-era FaZe.

moments.title: Announces SPAC merger, ~$1B valuation
moments.summary: Announces SPAC merger, ~$1B valuation A definitive agreement with B. Riley Principal 150 Merger Corp., reported as the highest valuation ever for an esports company.

moments.title: ZooMaa comes home ZooMaa returns to FaZe just over two years after his transfer, announced
moments.summary: ZooMaa comes home ZooMaa returns to FaZe just over two years after his transfer, announced with “HE’S HOME.”

moments.title: Wins the Six Sweden Major
moments.summary: Wins the Six Sweden Major — the first Rainbow Six trophy 3–2 over Ninjas in Pyjamas in Stockholm for $200,000, four years after the org bought its way into Siege by acquiring Team Fontt. This is the title the 2025 Six Invitational win is measured against when it is called the first in four years — and the start of a Rainbow Six run that outlasts everything else on this page.

moments.title: DraftKings partnership
moments.summary: DraftKings partnership — where the Kalish relationship starts DraftKings becomes FaZe's oﬃcial sports betting, iGaming and daily fantasy partner, with co-founder Matt Kalish quoted in the release calling FaZe “a juggernaut of internet engagement and culture.” The same Matt Kalish invests $11M in FaZe Media in 2024 and launches HardScope in December 2025. The thread that ends the story starts here, as a sponsorship.

moments.title: MoonPay crypto/NFT partnership, “FaZe Forever”
moments.summary: MoonPay crypto/NFT partnership, “FaZe Forever” A multi-year Web3 deal launched with an Art Basel Miami event. Read as forward-looking at the time; part of a crypto push that ages poorly in hindsight.

moments.title: The Halo core is unveiled
moments.summary: The Halo core is unveiled Three and a half months after FaZe is named a Halo Championship Series partner team, the Inconceivable core of Snip3down, bubu dubu, Falcated and Bound is unveiled. It debuts at HCS Raleigh on Dec 17.

moments.title: Ad Age names FaZe one of its Best Marketers of 2021 Capping a year of Nissan, McDonald's,
moments.summary: Ad Age names FaZe one of its Best Marketers of 2021 Capping a year of Nissan, McDonald's, Corona, DraftKings, MoonPay, SteelSeries, General Mills and NFL work. The commercial peak of the pre-IPO business. 2022

moments.title: A FaZe toy blaster hits Target shelves
moments.summary: A FaZe toy blaster hits Target shelves The ZURU X-Shot FaZe Clan line, two years in development — a gaming brand turning up in the toy aisle of a national retailer.

moments.title: Reveals “The Warehouse,” a new Hollywood HQ Banks previews a still-under-construction cont
moments.summary: Reveals “The Warehouse,” a new Hollywood HQ Banks previews a still-under-construction content studio and production headquarters, purpose-built for a new Twitch original-format push.

moments.title: NFL partnership, ahead of Super Bowl LVI
moments.summary: NFL partnership, ahead of Super Bowl LVI A co-branded flag-football event with Brett Favre and Michael Vick as quarterbacks (Feb 13) and $25,000 committed to youth sports; the partnership extends into the following season.

moments.title: Wins IEM Katowice
moments.summary: Wins IEM Katowice — the first leg of a Grand Slam 3–0 over G2 for $400,000, a month after ropz completes the roster karrigan returned to lead. It opens the best year any FaZe team has had in any game: Katowice in February, ESL Pro League Season 15 in April, the Antwerp Major in May, IEM Cologne in July.

moments.title: Snoop Dogg joins the board, and the roster Takes a Board of Directors seat and becomes a t
moments.summary: Snoop Dogg joins the board, and the roster Takes a Board of Directors seat and becomes a talent member in the same announcement — the org's highest-wattage celebrity aﬃliation, timed four months ahead of the public listing.

moments.title: “Unfazed,” a weekly Twitch variety show, launches
moments.summary: “Unfazed,” a weekly Twitch variety show, launches An “SNL-style” live show and a stated three-year original-programming strategy — an ambitious bet that's largely forgotten today.

moments.title: FaZe Deestroying signs Donald De La Haye
moments.summary: FaZe Deestroying signs Donald De La Haye — the UCF kicker the NCAA ruled ineligible in 2017 for monetizing his own YouTube channel, a case now credited as an early catalyst for NIL reform — joins with over 4M subscribers. “I remember watching FaZe Clan when I was 12 years old.” Apr–

moments.title: Six commercial deals in six weeks, and a creative studio Respawn as oﬃcial gaming chair pa
moments.summary: Six commercial deals in six weeks, and a creative studio Respawn as oﬃcial gaming chair partner (Apr 8), an exclusive long-term deal with the banking app

moments.title: “FaZe1: The Warehouse” launches, then stumbles on COVID
moments.summary: “FaZe1: The Warehouse” launches, then stumbles on COVID A 24/7, 15-day livestreamed recruitment competition out of the new warehouse studio — $1M in crypto, a sponsorship deal and a Nissan GT-R on the line — disrupted days in when five contestants test positive and are disqualified, drawing fan backlash over the handling.

moments.title: Wins the PGL Major, Antwerp (May 22)
moments.summary: Wins the PGL Major, Antwerp (May 22) — first Major title Beats Natus Vincere 2-0 in the grand final: the first-ever mixed-nationality roster to win a CS:GO Major, and easily the org's single biggest competitive trophy across any title. HLTV names FaZe its Team of the Year.

moments.title: Zach Katz arrives as president and COO
moments.summary: Zach Katz arrives as president and COO A music executive — formerly president of BMG US — takes the number-two job two months before the Nasdaq listing. The hire signals where the company thought it was going: not an esports org with a content arm, but a media company with a team.

moments.title: Disney “Mickey On
moments.summary: Disney “Mickey On The Grid” apparel collab A year-long licensed capsule collection, launched at FaZe's Armory pop-up — part of a stated push into retail and consumer products. Jul 3–4,

moments.title: Cented removed for a racial slur Fortnite pro
moments.summary: Cented removed for a racial slur Fortnite pro Evan “Cented” Barron is permanently cut after video surfaces of him using a slur on a Discord call.

moments.title: Wins IEM Cologne, two days before the listing 3–2 over Natus Vincere for $400,000
moments.summary: Wins IEM Cologne, two days before the listing 3–2 over Natus Vincere for $400,000 — the third S-tier title of the year and the third leg of the Intel Grand Slam. FaZe go public forty-eight hours later as the best team in Counter-Strike. Jul 19–20,

moments.title: Goes public: trades on Nasdaq as FAZE SPAC merger completes at a $725M valuation, below th
moments.summary: Goes public: trades on Nasdaq as FAZE SPAC merger completes at a $725M valuation, below the original $1B target. Opens around $13/share and closes its first day down about 25%.

moments.title: The NFL 1ON1 tour hits preseason cities Deestroying's 1ON1 format goes on the road with th
moments.summary: The NFL 1ON1 tour hits preseason cities Deestroying's 1ON1 format goes on the road with the NFL, starting at the Dolphins' training complex and Ford Field in Detroit, free to the public.

moments.title: Stock hits its all-time high, ~$20–$25 Market cap briefly around $1.2B
moments.summary: Stock hits its all-time high, ~$20–$25 Market cap briefly around $1.2B. The peak of the public-company era, and the last good month.

moments.title: McDonald's renews
moments.summary: McDonald's renews A year on from the first deal, the renewal is announced six weeks after the listing — the proof point that a quick-service giant will re-sign rather than test once and leave.

moments.title: “FaZe World”
moments.summary: “FaZe World” — a metaverse land grab with The Sandbox The org buys into The Sandbox to build a branded virtual space, nine months after the MoonPay deal and at the exact top of the Web3 cycle. Nothing in the 2024 reboot survives from it. Sep 26–29,

moments.title: Insider lock-up crash SEC filings clear nearly 64M shares (about 80% of the company) for i
moments.summary: Insider lock-up crash SEC filings clear nearly 64M shares (about 80% of the company) for insider sale at once; stock falls from ~$14.80 toward $5 in a week. A separate $71.4M funding shortfall and ~92% SPAC-shareholder redemption compound it.

moments.title: Xfinity becomes oﬃcial internet and mobile partner
moments.summary: Xfinity becomes oﬃcial internet and mobile partner A telecoms deal signed three weeks after the lock-up crash. The stock is falling and the sponsorship sheet is still filling; the gap between those two lines is the whole story of the public year. 2023

moments.title: Co-founder Temperrr loses to KSI in a first-round KO
moments.summary: Co-founder Temperrr loses to KSI in a first-round KO A last-minute replacement fight at Wembley Arena, and one of the most fan-memorable “founder does an influencer boxing match” moments of the era.

moments.title: Porsche multi-year partnership Original content, an oﬃcial-esports-partner designation, an
moments.summary: Porsche multi-year partnership Original content, an oﬃcial-esports-partner designation, and consumer/digital products — brokered by UTA.

moments.title: Stock closes below $1 for the first time Starts the Nasdaq minimum-bid-price compliance cl
moments.summary: Stock closes below $1 for the first time Starts the Nasdaq minimum-bid-price compliance clock.

moments.title: Fields a Valorant Challengers roster
moments.summary: Fields a Valorant Challengers roster A direct invite (no open qualifiers) into VCL North America, never a franchised VCT team — poised, supamen, dicey, babybay, Rossy. A short, mid-tier run. Feb 13 & 22,

moments.title: A BAPE capsule, then a FaZe flavour of GHOST
moments.summary: A BAPE capsule, then a FaZe flavour of GHOST A limited-edition collaboration with A Bathing Ape, then “FaZe Pop”, a co-created flavour of GHOST Energy and GHOST Gamer. Two of the last consumer launches before the first layoffs, three days later.

moments.title: First layoffs, ~20% of staff CEO Lee Trink cites economic uncertainty: “our original IPO p
moments.summary: First layoffs, ~20% of staff CEO Lee Trink cites economic uncertainty: “our original IPO plans contemplated raising significantly more capital.”

moments.title: Signs its first all-female pro esports team
moments.summary: Signs its first all-female pro esports team An all-women VALORANT Game Changers roster (panini, Emy, di^, maddiesuun, refinnej); Head of Esports Erik Anderson calls it “just the beginning.” No trophies across two series before the team is dropped.

moments.title: Teeqo's “Dear FaZe Clan”
moments.summary: Teeqo's “Dear FaZe Clan” A longtime member says newcomers got better deals than veterans, that his contracts carried “fake promises,” and that after 12 years “I don't matter for sh*t.” FaZe issues a corporate response nine days later: “We know that for too long we haven't been the FaZe we need to be.” The clearest early statement of the grievance that resurfaces in the 2025 exodus.

moments.title: Completes the Intel Grand Slam (Mar 26) Wins ESL Pro League Season 17 to finish the Slam
moments.summary: Completes the Intel Grand Slam (Mar 26) Wins ESL Pro League Season 17 to finish the Slam — the first international (mixed-nationality) roster to do it, and the CS side's second major milestone in under a year. Mar 21–22,

moments.title: CBass's response video, and the backlash that follows him out
moments.summary: CBass's response video, and the backlash that follows him out Sebastian “CBass” Diamond — in FaZe since 2010, its first employee and longest-serving one — posts a 14-minute video replying to Teeqo. He says he agrees Teeqo should have been paid more, but that FaZe had “put a roof over his head” and the dispute should have stayed private. The roof line is what sticks. FaZe Rain calls him “part of the problem and why FaZe has been dying,” and on May 2 tweets that he's leaving the org “until we publicly kick CBass.” Notably, the loudest pressure came from inside the roster rather than from fans.

moments.title: Nasdaq delisting deficiency notice 30+ consecutive days under $1; stock trading around $0
moments.summary: Nasdaq delisting deficiency notice 30+ consecutive days under $1; stock trading around $0.40–$0.80. Co-founder Rain publicly accuses the company of having “sold out” its talent.

moments.title: Founders rumored to be selling 62.5% of shares
moments.summary: Founders rumored to be selling 62.5% of shares An SEC filing sparks “founders jumping ship” reports; Banks and CEO Trink both publicly deny selling, calling it a lock-up expiration, not a sale.

moments.title: Second layoffs, ~40% of remaining staff
moments.summary: Second layoffs, ~40% of remaining staff A far deeper cut than February's, amid continued financial distress.

moments.title: Grace Van Dien signing draws internal backlash
moments.summary: Grace Van Dien signing draws internal backlash The Stranger Things actor's signing is called inauthentic by parts of FaZe's own community, including FaZe Rain; a tense private meeting reportedly ends with Van Dien in tears, and she later speaks publicly about toxicity toward women in gaming. Jun 14–15,

moments.title: Pamaj leaves FaZe, and rejoins OpTic the next day He announces the exit in a YouTube video
moments.summary: Pamaj leaves FaZe, and rejoins OpTic the next day He announces the exit in a YouTube video, implying the org had changed, and is back in OpTic colours within 24 hours. It closes a loop that ran eleven years: FaZe in 2012, OpTic from 2013, FaZe again from

moments.title: Deestroying's NFL tour goes global, and to the Pro Bowl
moments.summary: Deestroying's NFL tour goes global, and to the Pro Bowl A 10-city 1ON1 tour including London, with two winners per position from each city advancing to compete at the 2024 Pro Bowl. He also appears onstage with Roger Goodell at YouTube's Brandcast tied to the Sunday Ticket deal, and on NFL Network's Good Morning Football. Worth noting the episodes ran on his own channel; NFL-owned surfaces carried the promotion and interviews.

moments.title: Drops its Valorant roster; Game Changers team follows in September Citing scheduling uncer
moments.summary: Drops its Valorant roster; Game Changers team follows in September Citing scheduling uncertainty in Challengers; the women's GC roster (still without a trophy) is cut Sept 22, amid the same month's CEO firing and delisting pressure. Ends FaZe's competitive Valorant experiment after seven months.

moments.title: Kaysan confirms a minority stake in Atlanta FaZe
moments.summary: Kaysan confirms a minority stake in Atlanta FaZe A FaZe creator takes an ownership position in the Call of Duty franchise rather than a salary from it. It is the first public sign of the split the org formalises a year later — the esports assets and the creator roster owned through different doors.

moments.title: YourRage signs as the newest oﬃcial member
moments.summary: YourRage signs as the newest oﬃcial member A smaller signing, overshadowed within weeks by the GameSquare acquisition news — but he's still on the roster for the 2025 subathons.

moments.title: Board chairman resigns Stock near $0.25 (~97% down from the SPAC close); H1 2023 net loss
moments.summary: Board chairman resigns Stock near $0.25 (~97% down from the SPAC close); H1 2023 net loss of $28.4M on $24.2M revenue. At least 16 executives/board members have left since May 2022.

moments.title: FaZe floats an FC Black Challengers team FaZe asks, “Should ZooMaa and Kaysan bring FC Bla
moments.summary: FaZe floats an FC Black Challengers team FaZe asks, “Should ZooMaa and Kaysan bring FC Black to CDL Challengers?” FC Black win Challengers at CDL Major I on Jan 28, 2024.  Sep 9–10,

moments.title: CEO Lee Trink terminated Removed by the board with immediate effect; stock around $0.18, d
moments.summary: CEO Lee Trink terminated Removed by the board with immediate effect; stock around $0.18, down ~98.6% from its post-SPAC open. Christoph Pachler steps in as interim CEO.

moments.title: FaZe Arcade goes to Las Vegas, presented by Xfinity
moments.summary: FaZe Arcade goes to Las Vegas, presented by Xfinity A gaming-lounge activation in Las Vegas, four years after the Melrose storefront. The retail idea keeps coming back in lighter forms — store, then pop-up, then a lounge with a sponsor's name in front of it. Oct 13–15,

moments.title: Halo world champions
moments.summary: Halo world champions — the forgotten trophy FaZe come through the lower bracket at the Seattle Convention Center and beat the defending champions OpTic 4–0 in the grand final to win the Halo World Championship, taking $400,000 of a $1,000,000 pool. A world title in a fourth discipline, won five weeks after the CEO was terminated and five days before the

moments.title: GameSquare announces acquisition, ~$17M About 98% below the SPAC peak, but it keeps the co
moments.summary: GameSquare announces acquisition, ~$17M About 98% below the SPAC peak, but it keeps the company alive. Founders Banks, Temperrr and Apex return to operating roles as CEO, President and COO. Nov 6 & 16,

moments.title: SteelSeries gear, and ten billion views on GIPHY
moments.summary: SteelSeries gear, and ten billion views on GIPHY A multi-year SteelSeries partnership launches co-branded hardware, and the org marks ten billion cumulative views on its GIPHY library — a reach number nobody else in gaming was quoting, and close to the last good news it publishes as an independent company.

moments.title: Wins the CS Asia Championships 2–0 over MOUZ for $250,000
moments.summary: Wins the CS Asia Championships 2–0 over MOUZ for $250,000 — the roster's first title since the Grand Slam in March, and its only trophy in a year the organisation spent mostly in its own boardroom. Dec 4–5,

moments.title: CBass leaves after 12 years FaZe's longest-serving employee announces his exit two months
moments.summary: CBass leaves after 12 years FaZe's longest-serving employee announces his exit two months after the founders regain control through GameSquare, writing that he had “spent years sitting across the table from executives who effectively told us, 'thanks kids, we'll take it from here!'” Press coverage at the time reported fans as devastated rather than triumphant, which sits awkwardly against how the episode is often remembered. 06 2024-26 — Rescue, split, exodus, and the trophies that stayed 2024

moments.title: Nike puts FaZe branding on a LeBron shoe
moments.summary: Nike puts FaZe branding on a LeBron shoe The LeBron Nxxt Gen carries FaZe marks and is debuted on court by Sierra Canyon. Six weeks before the Nasdaq delisting completes, the brand is still worth putting on a Nike silhouette.

moments.title: Deestroying signs with the UFL's San Antonio Brahmas Seven years after the NCAA ended his
moments.summary: Deestroying signs with the UFL's San Antonio Brahmas Seven years after the NCAA ended his college eligibility over a YouTube channel, he makes a pro roster while still a FaZe creator. He fractures vertebrae on a kickoff return that April, returns in October, and kicks a 55-yarder in 2025.

moments.title: GameSquare shareholders approve the merger Clears the path for the acquisition to close. F
moments.summary: GameSquare shareholders approve the merger Clears the path for the acquisition to close. Feb 13–25,

moments.title: Runner-up at the Six Invitational
moments.summary: Runner-up at the Six Invitational Loses the R6 Siege final 2–3 to w7m esports — a crushing near-miss the roster turns around the very next

moments.title: Acquisition completes; FAZE delists from Nasdaq FaZe survives as a going concern under new
moments.summary: Acquisition completes; FAZE delists from Nasdaq FaZe survives as a going concern under new ownership. Banks becomes CEO of the combined entity.

moments.title: rain becomes the longest-serving player at one org in Counter-Strike history Håvard “rain”
moments.summary: rain becomes the longest-serving player at one org in Counter-Strike history Håvard “rain” Nygaard passes EliGE's 3,013 days at Team Liquid, having arrived in the January 2016 roster purchase and never left: over 1,500 maps, a Major and a Grand Slam for one badge. He is benched in September 2025 and released that October, ending the longest continuous player-org relationship the sport has had. Apr 27–28,

moments.title: Post-acquisition reboot: 17 creators out Cizzorz, Sway, Nate Hill, H1ghSky1, Rain, Nikan a
moments.summary: Post-acquisition reboot: 17 creators out Cizzorz, Sway, Nate Hill, H1ghSky1, Rain, Nikan and others are cut as the roster is trimmed toward ~14 members. Among them: Blaze (Lucas Mosing), a director-role member since January 2015, and reportedly Teeqo, on the roster since 2011 — two of the longest-tenured names in the org, gone in a single announcement. Banks says the departing creators were “furthest from how we want FaZe represented.” Apr 28 –

moments.title: The new class arrives: four signings in four days With the old roster barely out the door,
moments.summary: The new class arrives: four signings in four days With the old roster barely out the door, FaZe signs a Twitch-native replacement class one per day: Plaqueboymax first (~Apr 28), Silky second (Apr 29), JasonTheWeen third (Apr 30), Lacy fourth (May 1). Adapt, a member since the late-2013 #FAZE5 class, stays on rather than joining fresh. This is the group the reboot is built around — and, apart from Plaqueboymax leaving early in Aug 2025, the same names that walk out together at Christmas 2025 and found CORE.

moments.title: DraftKings co-founder Matt Kalish invests $11M Takes a 49% stake in FaZe Media and a board seat
moments.summary: DraftKings co-founder Matt Kalish invests $11M Takes a 49% stake in FaZe Media and a board seat — fresh capital, and the seed of the conflict that ends the year after next.

moments.title: A separate Miami content house stands up for the new signing class Plaqueboymax announces
moments.summary: A separate Miami content house stands up for the new signing class Plaqueboymax announces a Miami house for himself, Silky, JasonTheWeen and Lacy, distinct from the LA house — YourRage later says he left a related house citing burnout he calls “clip farm disease.”

moments.title: Selected for the Esports World Cup Club Support Program
moments.summary: Selected for the Esports World Cup Club Support Program A six-figure stipend plus annual funding from the Esports World Cup Foundation. Two years later that same event is where FaZe wins its Rainbow Six world title.

moments.title: The $25K Kaysan Showdown
moments.summary: The $25K Kaysan Showdown A $25,000 creator Call of Duty tournament presented by Xfinity, streamed on ZooMaa’s channel.

moments.title: GameSquare forms FaZe Media, splitting it from FaZe Esports GameSquare's own release creat
moments.summary: GameSquare forms FaZe Media, splitting it from FaZe Esports GameSquare's own release creates FaZe Media as a distinct entity: Banks as CEO, Matt Kalish investing $11M for 49%, GameSquare holding 51% — and explicitly states GameSquare will continue to own 100% of the esports competition assets under FaZe Esports. The two halves of the business formally part ways here, which is why the influencer roster can collapse in 2025 without touching the esports side.

moments.title: The Founding Fathers LAN Fourteen years to the day after the first upload, Banks, OpTic's
moments.summary: The Founding Fathers LAN Fourteen years to the day after the first upload, Banks, OpTic's H3CZ and 100 Thieves' Nadeshot put all three orgs in one room for a Call of Duty LAN — Modern Warfare 2 and Black Ops 2, 4v4, with snipers-only brackets. OpTic take both the BO2 Search and Destroy and the MW2 Headquarters events, FaZe second in each. Banks closes the night by beating Nadeshot 20–5 in a 1v1 on Rust, played on an Xbox 360. moments.title: Banks buys 25.5% of FaZe Media Ownership settles at Kalish 49% / Banks 25.5% / GameSquare
moments.summary: Banks buys 25.5% of FaZe Media Ownership settles at Kalish 49% / Banks 25.5% / GameSquare 25.5%.

moments.title: FaZe Scope's first montage as a FaZe member “BANDIT,”
moments.summary: FaZe Scope's first montage as a FaZe member “BANDIT,” 154K views on his own channel, with Banks filming a reaction video the next day (216K). The FaZe5 winner from 2020 becomes the org's most credible sniper — that October FaZe posts that “it hasn't even been a day and Scope is already the best sniper on Black Ops 6.” Aug 15–18,

moments.title: Atlanta FaZe win the Esports World Cup in Riyadh 4–2 over 100 Thieves on Modern Warfare II
